run_metadata.coverage_summary: Attempted the full source universe (Tier 1 core government, Tier 2 broader public sector / GBE, Tier 3 private). Direct page retrieval remained fully blocked this run: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for every external URL tested (including the AusTender ATM list and individual AusTender ATM detail pages), and the agent-proxy status endpoint confirmed the org egress policy denies CONNECT to external hosts (recentRelayFailures empty, selective=false). Per proxy policy, 403 org-policy denials were not retried or routed around, so no tender detail page, listing page, RSS/API feed or specification document could be opened directly; all capture is from WebSearch snippets, cross-verified across multiple independent queries, with any item whose close date had already passed (or could not be corroborated) rejected. Three genuinely new currently-open opportunities were captured this run, all Commonwealth via AusTender: (1) Geoscience Australia GA2026/1392 - open RFT for licensed GNSS CORS data streams, metadata and support for the National Positioning Infrastructure Capability (published 24 Jul 2026, closes 18 Aug 2026 5:00pm ACT); (2) DCCEEW ATM_2026_6066 - Australian Bushland Program REOI seeking Purchasing Partners for Strategic Property Purchases, the first stage of a multi-stage procurement (closes 3 Aug 2026 2:00pm ACT); and (3) Australian Army LCD-26-0030 - Army Innovation Day 2026 (AID26) RFI on 'Autonomous Mass in Littoral Warfare', recorded as market-sounding (responses open Jul 2026, invitations to participate issued from 17 Aug 2026, event 6-8 Oct 2026 Perth). Seven previously-seen opportunities were re-verified as still open and carried forward with their original first_seen dates: CSIRO RFT CSIRORFT2026019 Ground Maintenance VIC Metro (closes 17 Aug 2026), City of Sydney Christmas Trees & Decorations 2028-2032 design-concept EOI (closes 10 Aug 2026), Transport for NSW HW4 Log Creek Pavement Rehab Stage 2 Culvert Unit Supply (closes 4 Aug 2026), DCCEEW ATM_2026_6786 GEMS verification-testing laboratory panel (closes 12 Aug 2026), Western Power Clean Energy Link PCMS EOI (closes 31 Jul 2026, closing-soon), ANSTO ILWCI+ PSC002897 construction industry-briefing / upcoming-RFT notice (online briefing 31 Jul 2026, RFT intended early Aug 2026), and SA Water Millicent WWTP EIP Upgrade D&C EOI (closing date still unrecoverable behind SA Water's registration-gated Supplier Portal). Two genuinely new buyer-originated sources were recorded: the Victorian Health Building Authority (VHBA) health-infrastructure procurement channel and its parent the Victorian Infrastructure Delivery Authority (VIDA), both of which advertise EOI/RFP/RFT via the Buying for Victoria Supplier Portal. Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network, plus BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Santos, Coles, Woolworths, Qantas, banks, telcos, and energy/construction majors) was checked as required: no publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login, so no corporate tender was captured (portals remain registration-gated or invitation-only). Zero tenders, dates, deliverables or contacts were fabricated.
gaps: Direct page retrieval fully blocked again this run. WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for every external URL tested (https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm and multiple https://www.tenders.gov.au/Atm/Show/... detail pages); the agent-proxy status endpoint confirmed the org egress policy denies CONNECT to external hosts (recentRelayFailures empty, selective=false). The proxy README instructs not to retry 403/407 policy denials. Consequence: no ATM/RFT/EOI/REOI detail page, listing page, RSS/API feed or specification document could be opened; all detail is limited to cross-verified WebSearch snippets. Source-document deliverables/requirements extraction (evaluation criteria weightings, full document lists, mandatory conditions) was not possible for any entry this run.

SA Water Millicent WWTP EIP Upgrade D&C EOI: existence, buyer (SA Water), EOI nature and multi-stage design-and-construct scope were carried forward from prior runs but the exact EOI reference, closing date/time, evaluation criteria and value remain visible only inside SA Water's registration-gated Supplier Portal and could not be recovered behind the 403 wall - retained at headline+scope level with closing_date null.

ANSTO ILWCI+ (PSC002897): this AusTender notice is an industry-briefing / early-RFT notice, not yet an open RFT. Buyer (ANSTO, Lucas Heights), scope (new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility, ~10-year capacity extension) and the online industry-briefing purpose are well corroborated, but the exact briefing date/time, interest-registration deadline, RFT release date, tender reference and documents will only be confirmable once the RFT is published (intended early Aug 2026). Recorded as procurement_type=market-sounding.

Army Innovation Day 2026 RFI (LCD-26-0030): confirmed as a current Defence RFI/market-sounding on 'Autonomous Mass in Littoral Warfare' (responses open Jul 2026, invitations from 17 Aug 2026, event 6-8 Oct 2026). The exact RFI response closing date/time and the list of RFI documents are behind the AusTender 403 wall; recorded at headline+scope level with closing_date null.

City of Sydney Christmas Trees & Decorations 2028-2032 design-concept EOI and Transport for NSW HW4 Log Creek Culvert Unit Supply: carried forward and still open, but exact tender reference numbers, evaluation criteria and document lists remain unrecoverable behind the TenderLink / buy.nsw 403 walls (headline level).

Western Power Clean Energy Link PCMS EOI: carried forward, closing within days (EOI due 31 Jul 2026, closing-soon). Exact EOI reference, evaluation criteria and value remain behind the registration-gated + 403-blocked Opportunities Hub.

Search snippets again surfaced closed/stale items as if current (e.g. AusTender RFT-2026-0080 Federal Court Primary Dispute Resolution closed 7 Apr 2026; ATM_2026_6047 DCCEEW 'Game On' climate grants closed 5 May 2026; AACAP 2026-P04 Defence returned a 'Closed ATM View'; Sydney Water WS5192918179 Drinking Water Program EPCM EOI and Melbourne Water Greenvale Reservoir CCTV EOI, both long closed). These were date-checked and REJECTED, not recorded.

Tier-1 state/territory portals (buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria/buyingfor.vic, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were reachable only as landing pages via search; individual open state tenders generally could not be drilled into or date-verified behind the 403 wall, so apart from the carried-forward TfNSW HW4 Culvert package and City of Sydney EOI no new state/local-portal opportunity could be confirmed at a trustworthy level of detail this run.

Tier-3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network, plus BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Santos, Coles, Woolworths, Qantas, banks, telcos, EstimateOne construction packages): checked as required. No publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login; corporate opportunities remain registration-gated or invitation-only, so none were captured as tenders (no corporate entries fabricated).

tenders.title: Provision of GNSS CORS Data Streams for the National Positioning Infrastructure Capability (NPIC)
tenders.description: Geoscience Australia invites tenders for the provision of licensed Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) Continuously Operating Reference Station (CORS) data streams, associated metadata and related support services, for integration into the National Positioning Infrastructure Capability (NPIC).
tenders.deliverables_summary: The supplier is to provide access to existing third-party GNSS CORS infrastructure - delivering licensed GNSS data streams plus associated metadata and support services - so Geoscience Australia can enhance positioning performance, availability, resilience and coverage within identified Priority Positioning Areas across Australia as part of the NPIC.
key_deliverables: Licensed GNSS CORS data streams from existing third-party reference-station infrastructure
Associated station metadata
Related support services for integration into NPIC
tenders.scope_of_work: The procurement seeks to enhance positioning performance, availability, resilience and coverage through access to existing third-party GNSS infrastructure within identified Priority Positioning Areas across Australia, feeding the National Positioning Infrastructure Capability. Full scope is in the RFT documents on AusTender (not retrievable this run behind the 403 wall).
tenders.eligibility: Open to all suppliers able to provide licensed GNSS CORS data streams meeting the RFT requirements (full eligibility detail in RFT documents, not retrievable this run).
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM search snippet (GA2026/1392) cross-verified across two independent WebSearch queries
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of the AusTender ATM listing (buyer-originated Commonwealth portal); published 24 Jul 2026 within the 7-day window. Detail page 403-blocked, so captured from cross-verified snippets.
tenders.notes: Headline + scope confirmed and date-verified (published 24 Jul 2026, closes 18 Aug 2026 5:00pm ACT). RFT documents, evaluation criteria, value and contact remain behind the AusTender 403 wall.

No supply deliverable is contracted at this stage.

Potential invitation to participate in AID26 activities (issued from 17 Aug 2026)

Seeks technologies enabling autonomous systems operating collaboratively in contested littoral environments with scalability and affordability; successful systems may deliver sense, strike, electronic warfare, mobility and logistics effects with human-on-the-loop operation. Full RFI detail is on AusTender (not retrievable this run behind the 403 wall).
